decisions.reason: This illuminated candle arch still builds mainly on our established handcrafted seasonal expertise, and after several years we can improve it through routine workshop learning, even if the sound feature makes it somewhat less central than our classic items.
The one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to our core knowledge base and remains the kind of traditional product that a mature German craft producer is well placed to sustain in its assortment.

Despite the time given to it, the electronic music box remains relatively distant from our traditional craft competences, and with limited in-house R&D and little evidence of external knowledge partnerships, we would now reallocate resources toward products closer to our absorptive strengths.

The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid extends an established product architecture with a familiar decorative variation, so it can be retained and refined within our existing craftsmanship and sales logic.
